caption: The drawing depicts three intricately designed metal door knockers, illustrated in a combination of front and side views. All objects are rendered in shades of brass or gold, with highlights and shadows giving a three-dimensional appearance. The top section features a knocker with a geometric, symmetric backplate with lattice and step motifs flanked by round terminals, accompanied to the right by its side view, which displays the knob and handle extending outward. The middle object is a backing plate seen from the front, characterized by pointed, intersecting shapes and a central circular opening. Below, the third knocker has a similarly ornate, symmetrical pattern, with a large round-headed handle attached to a decorative plate composed of curved and pointed elements, accompanied by its side view showing the outward projection of the handle. There is a small scale in the lower left corner showing units labeled from 0 to 2, and in the bottom right corner, the name "P. Johnson" is printed. The backgrounds of the objects are plain and light-colored, and all are enclosed within a rectangular border.
title: Drawer Pulls and Key Plate
